title: Maternity Benefit Notice — WIC and Parenting-Class Bonus Trips on RideLink
content:
Pregnant members and members receiving preventive care receive bonus Non-Emergency Medical Transportation value-added trips for WIC visits and parenting classes.

**Rule.** WIC and parenting-class bonus trips follow maternity care: when the active Medicaid Managed Care Membership is in Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care and the member has at least one paid preventive claim with a service date in the last three months, the full WIC bonus of 8 trips is added to the year's value-added allotment; when exactly one of those two holds, the half WIC bonus of 4 trips is added; when neither holds, none is added.

The preventive claims are the member's claims under their Medicaid Managed Care Membership in the preventive service category, adjudicated as paid, with a service date in the last three months.

## Truth table

| Active membership in Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care | At least one paid preventive claim in the last three months | Bonus trips added |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 8 |
| Yes | No | 4 |
| No | Yes | 4 |
| No | No | None |

## Cases

*Hypothetical members:*

- Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care, one paid preventive claim two months ago: 8 bonus trips.
- Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care, the only preventive claim four months ago: that claim is outside the three months, so 4 bonus trips.
- Prairie Ridge Family Care, a paid preventive claim last month: 4 bonus trips.
